cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wikimed --flavours medicine_nopic --topic medical --name 'WikiMed medical encyclopedia' --description "Wikipedia's medicine articles: diseases, symptoms, drugs, anatomy, procedures and first aid. Text only." --queries 'migraine aura;anaphylaxis treatment;heat stroke;ankle sprain'
description: Wikipedia's medicine articles (about 71,000): diseases, symptoms, drugs, anatomy and procedures, in full. Overlaps with MedlinePlus (the same conditions in plain language) and FDA drug labels (official drug details).

About 1,000 plain-language health topics written by the U.S. National Library of Medicine (MedlinePlus): conditions, tests, symptoms and wellness. Small. Overlaps with WikiMed, which covers the same conditions in more technical depth.

Official U.S. drug labels (FDA) for prescription and over-the-counter medicines: uses, dosing, contraindications, warnings, side effects and interactions, one entry per drug. Overlaps with drug articles in WikiMed and with the online FDA lookup when Internet is on (this works offline).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-essentials --flavours 'top_mini|top_nopic' --topic general --name 'Wikipedia essentials' --description "The opening section of Wikipedia's most-read articles: people, places, history, science and culture." --queries 'Abraham Lincoln;photosynthesis;Mount Everest;World War II'
description: Only the first section (the summary) of each of Wikipedia's 50,000 most-read articles: people, places, history, science and culture. Overlaps with the Wikipedia science, history and geography packs, which have the full articles.

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-science --flavours 'physics_nopic,chemistry_nopic,molcell_nopic,astronomy_nopic,mathematics_nopic,earth_sciences_nopic|geology_nopic' --topic science --name 'Wikipedia science' --description 'Wikipedia articles on physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy, earth science and mathematics. Text only.' --queries 'speed of light;periodic table;mitochondria;black hole'
description: Full Wikipedia articles on physics, chemistry, molecular and cell biology, astronomy and mathematics. Text only. Overlaps a little with WikiMed (biochemistry and drugs) and with Wikipedia essentials (summaries of famous topics).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-history --flavours history_nopic --topic general --name 'Wikipedia history' --description 'Full Wikipedia history articles' --queries 'Roman Empire;French Revolution;Civil War'
description: Full Wikipedia articles on world history: civilizations, wars, empires, events and historical figures. Text only. Overlaps with Wikipedia essentials (summaries of the most famous ones) and Wikipedia geography (countries' history sections).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wiki-geography --flavours geography_nopic --topic general --name 'Wikipedia geography' --description 'Full Wikipedia geography articles' --queries 'Missouri River;Sahara;Japan climate'
description: Full Wikipedia articles on countries, regions, cities, rivers, mountains and climate. Text only. Overlaps with Wikipedia essentials (summaries), Wikipedia history, and Wikivoyage (which covers travel rather than facts).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wikivoyage --dir wikivoyage --prefix wikivoyage_en_ --flavours 'all_nopic|all_maxi' --site https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/ --credit 'Text from Wikivoyage, the free travel guide (Wikivoyage contributors), via Kiwix. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.' --topic travel --name 'Wikivoyage travel guide' --description 'Wikivoyage travel guide' --queries 'St. Louis;Yellowstone;Tokyo get around'
description: The free Wikivoyage travel guide: destinations, getting around, sights, where to stay, local safety and phrasebooks. Little overlap: Wikipedia geography has facts about places, Wikivoyage has practical travel tips.

U.S. Army survival manual (ATP 3-50.21) and first-aid manual (TC 4-02.1): shelter, water, fire, signaling, survival medicine, bleeding, burns, fractures. Overlaps with Wild edible plants (similar food chapters) and Navigation & preparedness (its navigation chapter is a shorter version).

U.S. Army map reading & land navigation (TC 3-25.26) and FEMA's Are You Ready? emergency preparedness guide: compass and map use, storms, floods, power outages, emergency supplies. Overlaps a little with Army survival (navigation basics).

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id appropedia --dir other --prefix appropedia_en_ --flavours 'all_nopic|all_maxi|all' --site https://www.appropedia.org/ --credit 'Text from Appropedia (Appropedia contributors), via Kiwix. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.' --topic survival --name 'Appropedia (off-grid how-to)' --description 'Appropedia' --queries 'solar cooker;rainwater harvesting;composting toilet'
description: Appropedia's practical how-to wiki for off-grid and sustainable living: water filtration, solar power, cooking, shelter, sanitation, farming. Overlaps a little with Army survival and Navigation & preparedness (water, shelter, emergencies).

U.S. Army field manual chapters on finding and testing wild food plants, the universal edibility test, edible and medicinal plants, and poisonous plants. Overlaps with Wikipedia plants & fungi and USDA PLANTS (same species, different detail).

Wikipedia articles on about 42,000 plants, trees, wildflowers, mushrooms and other fungi; full articles for edible, toxic or medicinal species. Overlaps with Wild edible plants (survival use) and USDA PLANTS (names).

Names of every plant in the U.S. from the USDA PLANTS Database: common and scientific names, families, older names. Names only, no descriptions; pairs with Wikipedia plants & fungi and Wild edible plants, which describe them.

cmd: python builders/zim.py --id wikibooks-cookbook --dir wikibooks --prefix wikibooks_en_ --flavours 'all_nopic|all_maxi' --title-prefix 'Cookbook:' --site https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/ --credit 'Text from the Wikibooks Cookbook (Wikibooks contributors), via Kiwix. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.' --topic food --name 'Wikibooks Cookbook' --description 'Wikibooks Cookbook' --queries 'bread;pancakes;canning;substitute eggs'
description: The Wikibooks Cookbook: thousands of recipes plus cooking techniques, ingredients, substitutions and food preservation. No overlap with the other packs.
